data.title: Numbers to 10 on a Ten Frame
data.description: Explore numbers up to 10 by building, subitizing, and making ten on the ten frame.

challenges.hint: Count the empty spaces left to reach ten.
challenges.narration: How many more counters do we need to make ten?
challenges.instruction: There are 6 counters on the frame. How many more do you need to make 10?

challenges.hint: Change some of the red counters to yellow to show two parts.
challenges.narration: Let us split five into two different colors.
challenges.instruction: Turn some of the 5 counters yellow to make two groups!

challenges.hint: Count out four counters one by one.
challenges.narration: Can you put four counters on the ten frame?
challenges.instruction: Put 4 counters on the ten frame!

challenges.hint: Look closely at the pattern before it hides.
challenges.narration: How many counters do you see?
challenges.instruction: How many counters did you see?

challenges.hint: Fill the top row completely and add two more on the bottom.
challenges.narration: Let us build the number seven on the frame.
challenges.instruction: Put 7 counters on the ten frame!

challenges.hint: Notice how the top row is completely filled.
challenges.narration: Quickly, how many dots flashed on the screen?
challenges.instruction: How many counters did you see?
